create_videomae_model: create a VideoMAEModel to extract hidden states from video pixel values with optional masked positions
run_videomae_pretraining: run VideoMAEForPreTraining to reconstruct masked video patches and compute pixel reconstruction loss
build_videomae_classifier: build a VideoMAEForVideoClassification model with a linear head for video classification on Kinetics-400
create_decoder_reconstruct: create a VideoMAEDecoder to reconstruct pixel logits from masked video encoder hidden states
review_videomae_embeddings: review VideoMAEEmbeddings and VideoMAEPatchEmbeddings for converting video tensors to patch embeddings with sinusoid position encoding
